intent: Implement U10 CSV/XLSX to fresh value-only typed XLSX downloads, preserving literal identifiers/formula-like text, exact representable numbers, calendar dates, blanks and selected order. Preserve U2–U9 validation, revision safety, privacy and workflow portability; reuse vendored SheetJS and U9 resource infrastructure.

requirements_completeness.scope: U10 only; U11-U13 are intentionally outside this review.

requirements.evidence: src/formats/xlsx-export.ts constructs explicit text/number/date cells and blank extent in configured order; src/processing.worker.ts selects the writer from the current workflow. tests/unit/xlsx-export.test.ts and tests/e2e/excel-output.spec.ts independently inspect ZIP/XML and library semantics.

Fresh output accepts evaluated Value objects only, isolates SSF formats and copies no source workbook metadata. Existing U9 import preflight, worker watchdog, cancellation and revision envelopes remain. Integrated privacy, hostile archive and cancellation tests are present.

implementation_units.evidence: CSV/XLSX downloads, output controls, exact numeric rejection, literal identifiers/formula-like text, both calendar epochs, selected order/blanks, version-1 saved/portable round trips, independent XML assertions and 10000 x 20 browser performance/privacy safeguards are implemented.

binding_decisions.evidence: Vendored SheetJS and existing archive qualification are reused. Fresh typed workbook serialization checks decimal equality/range before writing, uses integer calendar arithmetic and no active source objects. Integrated tests exercise hostile archive rejection and export cancellation; output cell/text/serialization limits fail without truncation.

requirements_completeness.verification_limit: Met records corresponding implementation and test coverage found by source inspection, not runtime certification. Parent owns final execution, cross-browser CI evidence and hands-on UX acceptance. Reference-device release qualification remains U13.

learnings.title: Qualify Excel archives before flattening cells
learnings.note: Preserve interpretation provenance, validate actual archive expansion and routing before SheetJS, and verify the integrated output XML. No violation was established.

residual_risks.title: Reference-device resource qualification remains a release obligation
residual_risks.detail: The output writer enforces table-position and estimated serialized-byte limits, but those estimates are not a peak-heap cap while evaluated rows, worksheet objects, shared strings, XML and compressed bytes coexist. The reviewed decision explicitly records this limit; reference-laptop qualification remains U13. No runtime measurements were executed in this review.
evidence: src/formats/xlsx-export.ts:13-14,69-89: 2 million table-position and 100 MiB serialization-estimate guards.
docs/decisions/excel-fidelity.md: Limits and remaining obligations and U10 value-only writer sections explicitly distinguish serialized budgets from process/heap bounds.
